exactAssertion.oracle: When requested/observed Sol-medium-Fast route or pinned loaded-skill receipt is absent/different, report acceptance must remain false, research must stay open, and Luna/paid fallback must not satisfy the research requirement.

existingNineDiagnostics.result: 9/9 diagnostics PASS in the saved unfiltered CLI run/show.
existingNineDiagnostics.coverageAssessment: Semantically covers the requested negative receipt cases: absent route, observed Luna, wrong effort/tier, absent/wrong skill bytes, and no module-local override. It keeps ordinary implementation on Luna. The serialized research receipts set acceptanceComplete:false; requested selections set paidFallbackPermitted:false and receipts set paidFallbackAttempted:false. The successful fixture maps external service_tier=fast to internal serviceTier=priority and has the pinned loaded digest.
existingNineDiagnostics.cannotCountAsAT3: The run is bound to AT-obligations-75, not AT-RESEARCH-REGISTER-3. Current AT3 has no authored manifest and neither CLI dispatch nor ModelRouteProbe's unfiltered branch recognizes its ID. The existing nine PASS entries therefore do not establish the exact registered AT3 assertion.
existingNineDiagnostics.oracleLimit: The fixture external CLI is fake and liveProviderSends is 0. All receipts intentionally set acceptanceComplete:false and nativeExecutionVerified:false; probe.show reads diagnostic receipts but does not inspect a persisted research report or durable obligation state. The current evidence supports refusal/no-acceptance at the receipt boundary only, not authenticated/native execution or a whole AT verdict. UID 501 in diagnostic output is the caller process observation and is not evidence of service identity.
